tables: Bush-Francis Catatonia Rating Scale scores over the trajectory of care  Note: Scores > 2 on at least two of the first 14 screening items indicate a positive catatonia diagnosis.  The Bush-Francis Catatonia Rating Scale (BFCRS) assesses severity by scoring symptoms from 0 to 3 across 23 items. Based on cumulative scores, catatonia is categorized as mild (1-9), moderate (10-19), or severe (≥20).
